dex.entry: A tiny firefly-sprite that bobs through Tinderwick's evening air, its tail-lantern blinking in rhythmic code only other Glimflit can read. It blinks at you with a friendly rhythm — kids will try to tap along.

art.silhouette: Transparent-winged insectoid sprite, thumbnail-sized; round mint-green body, a single amber bead tail-lamp that pulses on and off; long antennae tipped with spark-dots; silhouette reads as a floating comma at 16px.
